project.name: Seigyo and MyShop
project.type: Operational incident recovery plus causal commerce environment
project.audience: Incident responders, engineering teams, judges, and shoppers
project.stack: React 19, Tailwind 4, beUI source, Radix, Motion, Recharts
assumptions: The user asked the implementing agent to complete the build.

options.name: Black Vector
options.recommendationReason: Matches the approved Black Vector brief and the strongest research evidence.
options.description: Precise technical control with quiet confidence.
options.tradeoffs: Requires disciplined restraint and accurate semantic states.
